record.question: Padma Shri award 2014 was awarded to
record.explanation: Answer B: Pu C. Chhuanvawra. C.Chhuanvawra (Chhakchhuak Chhuanvawra) received the 2014 Padma Shri for Literature and Education. The original 2014 Government of India award list gives his name and Mizoram domicile. Lalthangfala Sailo's award was in a different year. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=102735. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
